verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists a first-party 'Sprints' product among its features. Its Jira importer migrates sprints and epics into ClickUp, which implies native sprint objects exist. Beyond these two mentions, the evidence never describes sprint planning or management itself. Missing for 10: documented sprint planning workflows (backlog grooming, capacity or points estimation, sprint start/close and rollover), sprint reporting such as burndown or velocity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sprint use.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development

citations.quote: Migrate your Jira issues, sprints, and epics into ClickUp seamlessly.
